register.labelZh: DO 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: do away with 可以表示取消舊制度;do without 則表示在缺少某事物時仍然應付得到。；DO 片語動詞可以描述不公平的批評、極度疲倦、襲擊和其他對人的重大影響。；do up 可以表示包好或扣好某物;do yourself up 與個人打扮有關;do something out 則與佈置地方有關。；do something with something 可以詢問物件放了在哪裏或會如何使用;do something withyourself 則表示找事情打發時間。；be done with something 表示一項工作、爭論或事物已處理完畢,不再需要理會。
register.summaryEn: Do away with can describe ending an old system, while do without describes managing when something is unavailable. The DO family can describe unfair criticism, serious tiredness, attacks and other strong effects on people. Do up can describe wrapping or fastening something. Do yourself up concerns personal appearance, while do something out concerns decorating a place. Do something with something can ask where an object went or how it will be used. Do something with yourself concerns keeping busy. Be done with something shows that a task, argument or object no longer needs attention.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間、結果和意思。；使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,請按照以上例子放在正確位置。；DO 片語動詞不會永遠出現在句子的同一位置,請仔細閱讀整句。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time, result and meaning. When using him, her, it or them, place the word as shown: do him down do it up do them over do her in The DO expression will not always appear in the same place. Read the complete answer carefully: to do without can do without has done without Doing without a car was difficult.
